wording_corrections.old: Use the concrete case as the shared normal case and the independent question as a second case. Each pair creates a boundary or missing-information case and predicts its result before testing. Keep the expected result separate from an observed mistake.
wording_corrections.new: Use the six-device case as shared practice. Each pair creates a missing-information or changed-evidence case and predicts what could be concluded before checking it. Keep the greenhouse for an individual first attempt before hints or feedback; do not use it as a paired lab example.

wording_corrections.old: Keep for an independent attempt: A toy follows your steering buttons. A photo app learned from labelled pictures. A talking clock follows a written timetable. Which uses a learned model? What evidence supports each classification?
wording_corrections.new: Optional later transfer practice: A toy follows your steering buttons. A photo app learned from labelled pictures. A talking clock follows a written timetable. Which uses a learned model? What evidence supports each classification? Keep the greenhouse as the selected independent assessment.
A Checklist for Explaining a Case

wording_corrections.old: Complete this after teaching and guided practice have ended.
wording_corrections.new: Use this checklist after practice. Complete the greenhouse case separately before feedback.

wording_corrections.old: REQUIRED PROOF  Classify six devices by mechanism, then defend two difficult cases with evidence.
wording_corrections.new: PRACTICE RECORD  Classify the six supplied devices by mechanism, then defend two difficult cases with evidence. These devices have already been used in teaching; do not count the same cases as a fresh assessment.

wording_corrections.old: Explain what this week adds to your project. Reuse last week’s record rather than starting again.
wording_corrections.new: Start this week’s project record. Name the classroom need and explain why your proposed process fits it.

preservation_note: Every original block and response position remains; the explicitly listed wording corrections remove contradictory assessment instructions and the Week 1 last-week reference.
section_block_partition_check: All 48 sections include every original-position block exactly once.
